finalMessage:
`ostf check --base main` now passes: 109 of 109 links are valid and it exits 0.

The failure was one link, `payments/refund.go#CheckRefundLimit implements R-REFUND-LIMIT`. It was unstamped and its lock entry no longer matched the code. The `refund-tweaks` merge had changed the function after the link was last stamped.

I rechecked it before stamping. The item says a refund can't exceed what's left of the charge, and refunds above 500.00 per account per UTC day need a second approval. `CheckRefundLimit` does exactly that, and `DailyRefundLimit` is 50_000, which is 500.00. `TestCheckRefundLimit` and `TestRefundDailyLimit` both pass. I then ran `ostf stamp` on the link.

The only file changed is `trace.lock`, and `ostf stamp` wrote it. I didn't edit it by hand. I didn't change any code or `trace.yaml`, so the item is still true and nothing new was added or linked.

Nothing is committed. `R-REFUND-LIMIT` is risk-relevant, so a human should review the stamp.
